title: Catalogs that rename only an operation's validators or an entry's mapping compile
summary: compileHarness now compares the input and output validators an operation descriptor lists, and the mapping an entry contract lists, with the names a record resolves to by installed name, as it already compares models. A catalog whose alias table renames an operation's validators but not the operation, or an entry's mapping but not the entry, was refused with IA-COMPOSITION-CONFLICT and now compiles. The alias such a listed name relies on is recorded in provenance.aliases, so compiledAliases still rebuilds the harness. A listed name the alias table sends to another entry is still refused, and compilations that already succeeded are unaffected. installedReadAdapters requires each read validator the compiled harness pins, found through its recorded aliases, to equal the first-party validator the read lists: when only the read's validators are renamed, a changed replacement, or one that is the read's other validator, is refused, and the original validator entries the harness no longer uses need not be installed.
